name: Ashnod the Uncaring
oracle_text:
Deathtouch
Whenever you activate an ability of an artifact or creature that isn't a mana ability, if one or more permanents were sacrificed to activate it, you may copy that ability. You may choose new targets for the copy. (Sacrificing an artifact for mana to activate an ability doesn't count.)
blocked_sentences: Whenever you activate an ability of an artifact or creature that isn't a mana ability, if one or more permanents were sacrificed to activate it, you may copy that ability. You may choose new targets for the copy. (Sacrificing an artifact for mana to activate an ability doesn't count.)

needs.what: an `ability_activated` trigger restriction (or event payload) that fires only when the activation's cost sacrificed one or more permanents -- the ability's own `sacrifice`/`sacrifice_x` cost, not permanents sacrificed by mana abilities used to pay it
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `game.py` fires ABILITY_ACTIVATED with only player/source/ability/card/mana_ability; `trigger_keys` (`mana_ability`, `filter`, `condition`) and `condition_keys` read the source's printed face or the board, nothing about what the cost paid

needs.what: copy the activated ability that caused this trigger ("copy that ability") with new_targets, without targeting it -- the stack item bound from the triggering event
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `copy_ability` reads stack refs from a target spec (`target`, default t1); a triggered ability saying "that ability" does not target, and the ability_activated event does not bind the new stack item's sid for the effect to read
